title: DVR and separable residue extension at a unit-root prime
statement: Let R be a DVR domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], let e>0 be a natural number which is a unit in R, and let v be a unit of R. Let q be a prime ideal of the explicit root algebra B=R[X]/(X^e-v) whose contraction to R is its maximal ideal. Then L=B_q is a domain and a DVR, the canonical map R->L is local and injective, and its induced residue extension k(L)/k(R) is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. The root algebra itself is not assumed to be a domain.

source.place: Tag 0BRM, first claim of the proof, local factors of the finite etale unit-root algebra; Tag 00PD, the unit-times-uniformizer-power criterion for a DVR.

proof.text: The polynomial P=X^e-v is monic of positive degree, hence B=R[X]/(P) is finite free over R. The defining equation makes its root a unit. Its derivative evaluates to e times the (e-1)-st power of the root, a unit. Use the standard-etale pair (P,P') and the root evaluation isomorphism to show B/R is etale.

For L=B_q, the equality q contracted to R equals the maximal ideal of R proves that R->L is local. Flatness is transitive along R->B->L; a flat local algebra is faithfully flat, so the map is injective. Finiteness of B gives that L is Noetherian. Localization preserves formal unramifiedness and essential finite type.

Choose a uniformizer pi of R. The formally unramified local algebra theorem gives m_R L=m_L and a separable residue extension. Mapping the principal description m_R=(pi) gives m_L=(a), with a the image of pi. Flatness preserves regular multiplication by pi, so multiplication by a is injective.

Krull intersection in the Noetherian local ring L says a nonzero x misses m_L^N for some N. Induction on N writes x=a^n*u with u a unit: if x is a unit, take n=0; otherwise x is in (a), write x=a*y, and y misses m_L^(N-1), so continue. If xy=0 and x is nonzero, this factorization and cancellation of a^n force y=0. Thus L is a domain. Regularity of a makes it nonzero, and m_L=(a) makes it a nonunit and irreducible. The unit-times-power factorization criterion proves L is a DVR. Package its domain, DVR, local map, separable residue extension and injectivity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BRM and 00PD; the domain and DVR assertions are proved explicitly by Krull intersection and uniformizer factorization.

mathlib_searches.query: A prime localization of a finite etale algebra over a discrete valuation ring above its closed point is a discrete valuation ring
A prime localization of a monic unit root algebra over a DVR is a discrete valuation ring with separable residue extension
mathlib_searches.results: Returned IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain, IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE and cotangent-space criteria. These already require a domain; they do not prove the local root algebra is a domain.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match; use the standard-etale and unramified local-ring APIs and prove the factorization argument.

mathlib_searches.query: Etale|FormallyUnramified in RegularLocalRing; isDomain in DiscreteValuationRing and local-ring modules; IsHausdorff in AdicCompletion/Noetherian; map_maximalIdeal in Unramified/LocalRing

from.place: Unit-root cover in the trait case: local factors of the finite etale root algebra are DVRs and have separable residue extension.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_unit_root_atPrime
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (e : ℕ) (hepos : 0 < e) (he : IsUnit (e : R)) (v : Rˣ)
    (q : Ideal (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e - Polynomial.C (v : R))))
    [q.IsPrime]
    (hq : q.comap (algebraMap R _) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ hdom : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q),
    letI := hdom
    ∃ hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q),
    letI := hdvr
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)),
    letI := hlocal
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) ∧
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q))
